title: Wine Tour Experience In Lake Country 5 Wineries
includes: Hotel & Accommodation pickup and drop off included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Welcome to the Lake Country Scenic Sip Wine Tour and the most sought after wine tour in the Greater Kelowna area. Located just 10 minutes north of the Kelowna International Airport lay the rolling hills and epic views of the Scenic Sip Wine Trail. 

Experience stunning vineyards, endless sunshine and jaw dropping architecture compete with some of the tastiest wines British Columbia has to offer. Showcasing the unique terroir of the region, relax and enjoy award winning wines and culinary delights. By far our most popular wine tour, the wineries along the Scenic Sip wine tour are sure to impress! 

Our full day Lake Country wine tour offers tastings at 5 award winning wineries, complete with vineyard walks and a leisurely pace. You will also enjoy a lunch reservation at a winery restaurant midway through the day (cost of lunch excluded).
